description: Conservation of glucan-lining positions versus the rest of the BcsD fold, and distance of the most conserved positions to the bound cellopentaose
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

B=framed("3A8E"); P=B[B.resn!="BGC"]; S=B[B.resn=="BGC"]
tg=cKDTree(S[["px","py","pz"]].values)
# per residue position (1-156), minimum distance to any glucan atom over all 8 chains
rec=[]
for (ch,ri),g in P.groupby(["uchain","resi"]):
    d=tg.query(g[["px","py","pz"]].values)[0].min()
    rec.append((ri,d))
R=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=["pos","d"]).groupby("pos").d.min().reset_index()
C=pd.read_csv("conservation_PF03500.csv")
M=C.merge(R,on="pos",how="inner")
M["lining"]=M.d<=4.5
print("positions with d<=4.5 A to glucan: n=%d"%M.lining.sum())
u,p=mannwhitneyu(M[M.lining].identity, M[~M.lining].identity, alternative="two-sided")
print("mean PF03500 identity  lining %.3f (n=%d)  vs non-lining %.3f (n=%d)   Mann-Whitney p=%.3f"%(
    M[M.lining].identity.mean(), M.lining.sum(), M[~M.lining].identity.mean(), (~M.lining).sum(), p))
# where are the most conserved positions?
top=M.sort_values("identity",ascending=False).head(12)
print("\n12 most conserved PF03500 positions and their distance to the bound glucan:")
print(top[["pos","aa","identity","d"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian distance of the top-12 conserved positions to glucan: %.1f A"%top.d.median())
arom=M[M.aa.isin(list("WYF"))]
print("\naromatic positions in P37719: n=%d, min distance to glucan %.1f A, none within 4.5 A: %s"%(
    len(arom), arom.d.min(), bool((arom.d>4.5).all())))
M.to_csv("conservation_vs_glucan_distance.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,5))
ax.scatter(M.d,M.identity,s=26,c=np.where(M.lining,"#c53030","#90a4b8"),edgecolor="k",linewidth=.3)
for _,r in top.iterrows():
    ax.annotate("%s%d"%(r.aa,r.pos),(r.d,r.identity),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,3),textcoords="offset points")
for _,r in M[M.lining].iterrows():
    ax.annotate("%s%d"%(r.aa,r.pos),(r.d,r.identity),fontsize=7,color="#c53030",xytext=(2,-9),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axvline(4.5,color="k",ls=":",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("minimum distance from residue to the bound cellopentaose (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("identity across 491 PF03500 sequences")
ax.set_title("The conserved core of BcsD lies away from the glucan site\nred = residues lining the site (within 4.5 A)")
ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
